informal_statement: Arc length of a unit-chord circular segment as a function of half-angle.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:89-91, the source contract is `noncomputable def ell (θ : ℝ) : ℝ := θ / sin θ`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
